blocks.text: Ezekiel 3 contains 27 verses. It opens with: And he said unto me, Son of man, eat that which thou findest; eat this roll, and go, speak unto the house of Israel. It concludes with: But when I speak with thee, I will open thy mouth, and thou shalt say unto them, Thus saith the Lord Jehovah: He that heareth, let him hear; and he that forbeareth, let him forbear: for they are a rebellious house.
